question_put_to_a_human: What are chapters 745 through 754 about, in one sentence? Put to a human before this file was written, as it has been put before every writer since 595. No human has answered it for any block from 595 onward. No writer answers it for them. It is recorded here unanswered and it stays open until somebody answers it.
family: THE FAMILY FOR THIS BLOCK IS DECLARED BEFORE ANY CHAPTER EXISTS AND IT IS A WRITER'S, NOT A HUMAN'S. Someone comes as far as the edge of someone else's place and does not come further, and the person inside keeps them there on purpose. Ten chapters, five standing figures, the young man sitting out because no second job is on the page, and in each chapter a visitor is met at a gate, a door, a passage runner, a kitchen doorway or a yard wall, is spoken with there, and is not brought past it. Nothing is measured, nothing is priced, nothing is added up, and no number is asked to agree with anything.
family_why_this_and_not_last_two: 0054 took none and gave its reason. 0055 took one built round a figure that does not agree with the thing it measures. A writer of 745 to 754 who takes either of those two positions unchanged has taken the last position and is repeating it. This block does not take none, and it does not take a figure. It takes a place-behaviour with no arithmetic in it: where people are allowed to stand. The test of a position is not whether it is defensible. It is whether it is the same one taken last time, and this one is neither.

family_tested_against_every_spent_family.595_604_small_thing_went_nowhere: Not this. Here every visit reaches its edge and stops there by decision, and the stopping is the scene. Nothing goes nowhere; it goes as far as it is allowed and stays there.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.605_614_carried_thing_could_not_put_down: Not this. Nothing is carried between people in the ten. Where a thing is in hand it stays in the hand of the person it belongs to, inside her own rooms.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.615_624_told_thing_could_not_place: Not this. Nothing is told as news that needs placing. What is spoken is spoken at the edge to someone already standing there, about the edge itself.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.625_634_decided_and_asked_why_and_gave_r: Not this. Nobody is asked why as the engine of a scene and nobody gives a reason as justification. People say where the visitor is to stay, and the visitor stays there.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.635_644_brought_thing_and_had_to_lie: Not this. Nobody brings a thing for another and nobody says what is false. Refusals in the ten are about rooms and doors, and they are spoken plain.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.645_654_woman_wrote_and_paper_left_house: Not this. No paper leaves any house in the ten. The envelope at twelve stays face up on the right of the table and is not turned. The paper at ten stays in its drawer.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.655_664_brush_carried_by_three_who_never: Not this. No object passes from one person to another anywhere in the ten. The brush on the runner at twelve is stepped over and not lifted. The brush in the bag in the drawer at the unit stays in the bag.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.665_674_room_she_will_not_sit_in_and_gat: Close enough to test hard and it does not touch. That family is about a room and a gate as standing refusals. Here the gate propped back and the front room not entered are furniture and are not chapters. The engine is the meeting at the edge, which moves from house to house, and no chapter is about the gate or the room.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.675_684_parcel_came_back_with_second_add: Not this. The taped box on the table at twelve stays taped under its cloth and is not the subject of any chapter. It is furniture in two chapters and does not move in either.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.685_694_step_ladder_round_four_houses_en: Not this. The ladder at twelve stays folded under the front window with tape on the second rail and chalk on the third. No ladder is opened, borrowed, carried or painted with in the ten. The two-tread stool at the unit is not a ladder.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.695_704_work_put_off_to_spring_with_ladd: Not this. Nothing is put off to a season. What is put off is a step across a runner, a step into a kitchen, a step into a yard, and each is decided on the day.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.705_714_water_coming_and_bowl_emptied: Not this. The bath tap at twelve does not drip and the bowl is on the shelf above the sink on its side with the ring on the tiles where it stood. No water is drawn, carried, emptied or waited for in the ten. The cistern four streets away is not touched.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.715_724_call_to_house_where_person_is_no: Not this. There is no telephone in this block. No bell rings, no receiver is lifted, no message is left, no line is put right. The machine and the telephone at twelve stand on the low table in the front room and are not touched.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.725_734_no_family_ten_scenes_each_standi: Not this. 0054 took none. This block takes one, and the one is stated above and is the same in all ten. No chapter stands alone apart from it.
family_tested_against_every_spent_family.735_744_number_right_and_person_will_not: Not this, and this is the finding that binds. That family was a figure that does not agree with the thing it measures, and it is spent as a spread. No chapter here is built round a figure, a measurement, a tally of things, a quantity, a price, or a mismatch between a number and its object. Where a standing tally is in a room it is furniture and is not spoken to make anything agree.

figure_rule_for_this_block: No engine with arithmetic. Ordinary domestic pairs (two cups, two mugs) appear as furniture in several chapters and are not tallies and are not worked on; no measurement, price, room tally or mismatch is the engine of any chapter. Corrected to the prose, which wins over the earlier draft of this row that allowed tallies in at most two chapters.
declared_ordinary_word_note: Declared in this file before any chapter of 745 to 754 existed and not after. It is not one of usually, anyway, like, just, enough, still, kind, quite, small, round, one, week, almost, anything, and then, nearly, and away, and count, all of which are spent and none of which is re-declared.

calendar.weekdays_checked: All ten taken off the real 2022 calendar. Tuesday, Saturday, Tuesday, Sunday, Wednesday, Sunday, Wednesday, Tuesday, Friday, Tuesday. calendar.what_may_not_be_printed: No day tally in body, dateline, opening or closing, and no closed clock time anywhere. What survives is tenure by month and season, age, date, and standing objects.

canon_scenes_turned_away_from.rule: No chapter re-stages a canon scene about a ladder, hatch, cistern, ballcock, coal shed, browse, brush or telephone ringing. Four step ladders on the page and no fifth appears in the ten. The travelling one stays folded at number twelve. The fixed four rungs by the hatch, the fibreglass one in the lamp man's van and the folded one in a semi back room are untouched. The two-tread stool in the unit corner is not a ladder and is not used as one. The brush on the passage runner at number twelve is stepped over and not moved. The brush in the bag in the drawer at the unit is not taken out. The coal shed door is not opened in any of the ten. The front room at twelve is not entered. The freeholder does not arrive. The line is not put right.

movement: Nothing is rescued. The freeholder does not arrive. No plate is unscrewed and no wire is spliced. The ladder is not opened and no room is painted. The box behind the bench is not opened. The drawer with leads and screws is not opened. The front room at twelve is not entered. The report is not chased. The envelope is not turned. The drawer at ten stays shut. What moves in the ten is where people are allowed to stand, and each chapter moves it once and leaves it there.
door_meetings: Ten of ten have somebody come as far as an edge and go no further. 0745 a sister at the back door of twelve, 0746 a lad with a van at the roller door, 0747 the woman who books work at the doors of the lock-up, 0748 the woman who does the shopping at the front door of nine, 0749 a sister at the gate of ten, 0750 a woman with a duster at the kitchen doorway of twelve, 0751 the man from the cottage at the yard gate, 0752 the woman who books work in the yard, 0753 a sister at the back door of nine, 0754 a boy at the fence of ten. The same two people at the same door in the same manner happens in no two chapters. The sister at twelve and the sister at ten are not compared. Corrected to the prose, which wins: the 0750 visitor is the woman with the duster and not a sister.
closing_images: Ten different ones. A cup in both hands in the green chair. A door half down over a bench. Doors to all but a hand width. Shopping put away in a kitchen. Standing at a window looking at a gate. Two cups washed and set away. Marking a line alone. Standing at doors looking into the dim. Standing at a back door with a cup. Washing a cup standing at a sink. The repeated hand-lift farewell stands in two chapters only, 0746 and 0748. Corrected to the prose, which wins.
